Treatment, then mediator 1, then mediator 2, then the outcome. Part of the
[Models](models.html) collection.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Structure** | X to M1 to M2 to Y (a chain), plus every skip path |
| **Class returned** | `SerialMediationData` |
| **Indirect effect** | the chain $a \, d_1 \, b$; `nie(type = "total")` adds the paths that skip a mediator |
| **Routes** | `extract_mediation(..., mediator = c(...), mediator_models = list(...))` on `lm`/`glm`, or a lavaan fit |

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(medfit)
library(generics)
```

## Fit it

One model per mediator plus the outcome model. Put every earlier mediator in
each later model, and every mediator in the outcome model.

```{r}
#| label: fit
fit_m1 <- lm(mediator1 ~ treatment + covariate1 + covariate2, mediation_demo)
fit_m2 <- lm(mediator2 ~ treatment + mediator1 + covariate1 + covariate2,
             mediation_demo)
fit_y <- lm(outcome ~ treatment + mediator1 + mediator2 + covariate1 +
              covariate2, mediation_demo)
x <- extract_mediation(fit_m1, model_y = fit_y, treatment = "treatment",
                       mediator = c("mediator1", "mediator2"),
                       mediator_models = list(fit_m2))
class(x)[1]
```

## Three effects, three meanings

```{r}
#| label: effects
c(chain = unname(nie(x)), every_path = unname(nie(x, type = "total")),
  total = unname(te(x)))
```

| Call | Counts |
|---|---|
| `nie(x)` | the full chain through both mediators only |
| `nie(x, type = "total")` | every path through at least one mediator, including the ones that skip |
| `te(x)`, `pm(x)` | every path (`te()` is the total effect, `pm()` the proportion mediated) |

## Limits

- The order of `mediator_models` is checked against the `mediator` vector; a
  misordered list fails with an error.
- The lm/glm route fits the equations separately, so the stored covariance sets
  the covariances among the chain paths to zero; a lavaan fit or a
  nonparametric bootstrap captures them. See [Model Extraction](extraction.html).
- `tidy(x, type = "effects", conf_int = TRUE)` gives delta-method intervals for
  the effects; for a bootstrap interval see [Bootstrap Inference](bootstrap.html).
